the beach boardwalk 🌊🎡🌴 i have been WAITING to color this page since the second i got this book, and she was absolutely worth the wait 🥹 thankfully, i have an “oopsy daisy” copy on the way because i already know i’m going to want another shot at this one! summer might be coming to an end, but that has never stopped me 😂 catch me coloring beach days in the middle of winter whenever i’m missing the sunshine, salty air, & ocean waves 🌊☀️ for this page, i imagined this gang spending the entire day at the beach before heading to the boardwalk carnival for one last adventure — rides, slushies, games, & watching the sunset over the water 🎡🌅 and please go show @Mia Coloring 🖍️ some love! her pages, artwork, & tutorials are seriously incredible, and i could scroll through her work forever 🫶🏻 #colorwithme #coloring #colortok #summerbreak #bobbiegoods  coloring book: summer break by @bobbiegoods  markers: @Ohuhuart
